Marketplace waybill synchronization

API for sending waybills to marketplaces.

get https://apiweb.shoplinker.co.kr/ShoplinkerApi/Order/DeliveryLinkage.php?iteminfo_url=XML_URL[URL-encoded]

Request Parameters

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. Required customer_id string Customer code (Shoplinker registration code) Code issued by Shoplinker
ex) a0000001
2. Required mall_id string Shoplinker marketplace code * Enter this code accurately. If the marketplace is not listed, add it in the marketplace setup.
ex )APISHOP_0001
3. master_id string Marketplace account (for bulk updates) For Auction/Gmarket, use the master account ID
For 11st, Interpark, and Smart Store, use the seller ID 		For open marketplaces Required .
Open marketplaces support single and multiple records per request
* Open marketplaces: Auction, Gmarket, 11st, Interpark, Smart Store
4. Required user_id string Marketplace account Enter the seller ID
5. Required order_id string Shoplinker order number

XML sample

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="euc-kr"?>
<Shoplinker>
	<OrderInfo>
	<customer_id>a0000018</customer_id>
	<mall_id><![CDATA[APISHOP_0001]]></mall_id>
	<master_id><![CDATA[shoplinker]]></master_id>
	<Delivery>
		<order_id>1234567</order_id>
		<user_id><![CDATA[shoplinker]]></user_id>
		<delivery_name><![CDATA[CJGLS]]></delivery_name>
		<delivery_invoice><![CDATA[1234567]]> </delivery_invoice>
		</Delivery>
		<Delivery>
		  내용..(오픈마켓[옥션,지마켓,인터파크,11번가,스마트스토어]만 멀티가 가능하며 그외 쇼핑몰은 1건씩 보내주시기 바랍니다)
		</Delivery>
		<Delivery>
		  내용
		</Delivery>
		  반복
		.
		.
		총 100개까지 가능
	</OrderInfo>
</Shoplinker>

Response

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. result bool Result flag Allowed values
  • - Success : true
  • - Failure : false
2. shoplinker_order_id string Shoplinker order number
3. mall_order_id string Marketplace order number May not be shown if synchronization fails
4. message string Result message 
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="EUC-KR"?>
<DeliveryInfo>
	<ResultMessage>
		<result>true</result>
		<shoplinker_order_id>12345</shoplinker_order_id>
		<mall_order_id>12345</mall_order_id>
		<message>송장전송 완료</message>
	</ResultMessage>
	<ResultMessage>
	  내용
	</ResultMessage>
	<ResultMessage>
	  반복
	  .
	  .
	  총 100개까지 가능
	</ResultMessage>
</DeliveryInfo>
